questions.stem:
Every Saturday, Mr Tan takes his grandson Wei Jie to the hawker centre near their flat in Tampines. (1) ________ they arrive, the stallholders greet them with a smile. Mr Tan always orders chicken rice, (2) ____ Wei Jie prefers fishball noodles. Mr Tan says the food here tastes just like the food he ate as a boy. Today the queue at the noodle stall was very long, (3) ____ they had to wait for a long time. While they were waiting, Wei Jie (4) ____ a boy from his class at the next table. The boy waved at Wei Jie, and Wei Jie waved back at (5) ____.

Which word or phrase best fits blank (1)?

explain.why: 'Until' marks the end of a period, not the moment they arrive
'Although' shows contrast, but greeting them is not in contrast with arriving
'Unless' means 'if not', which does not fit a regular event

solution: The sentence tells what happens at the time they arrive, so 'When' is the best link.

She read a few pages every night (2) ____ she finished it on Sunday. On Monday, she showed the book to her friend Amira, (3) ____ also likes animals. solution: Loving reading is the reason she visits the library, so 'so' is correct.

solution: The missing umbrella is the reason for Ravi's unhappiness, so 'because' fits.
